reading.title: The Impact of Renewable Energy on Global Economy
reading.passage: Renewable energy sources, including solar and wind power, have become increasingly cost-effective over the past decade. According to recent studies, the global renewable energy market is expected to grow significantly, creating millions of jobs worldwide. Countries investing heavily in clean energy infrastructure are experiencing economic benefits while reducing carbon emissions. This transition not only addresses climate change but also promotes sustainable development and energy independence for nations seeking to reduce reliance on fossil fuels.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one economic benefit of renewable energy investment?
options: A. It decreases the number of available jobs
B. It creates millions of jobs worldwide
C. It increases reliance on fossil fuels
D. It reduces government spending on infrastructure
questions.explanation: 패시지에서 재생에너지 시장이 전 세계적으로 수백만 개의 일자리를 창출할 것으로 예상된다고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 정답은 B번입니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about the cost of renewable energy?
options: A. It has become more expensive
B. It remains extremely costly and impractical
C. It has become increasingly cost-effective
D. The passage does not discuss cost
questions.explanation: 패시지의 첫 번째 문장에서 '지난 10년간 태양광과 풍력을 포함한 재생에너지원이 점점 더 비용 효율적이 되었다'고 언급되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of renewable energy?
options: A. Reducing carbon emissions
B. Promoting sustainable development
C. Ensuring energy independence
D. Increasing fossil fuel production
questions.explanation: 패시지는 화석 연료에 대한 의존도 감소를 언급하므로, 화석 연료 생산 증가는 재생에너지의 장점이 아닙니다. 정답은 D번입니다.

writing.prompt: Some people believe that technology has improved human life significantly. Others argue that it has created more problems than solutions. Which perspective do you agree with?

structure.intro: Opening sentence에서 당신의 입장을 명확히 표현하세요. 예: 'Technology has undoubtedly improved human life in numerous ways, despite some challenges it presents.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이점: 의료, 통신, 교육 등 구체적인 분야에서의 기술 발전을 예시로 들어 설명하세요.
structure.body2: 두 번째 이점 또는 반박: 일부 부정적 영향을 인정하면서도 그 이점이 더 크다는 점을 강조하세요. 예: 개인정보 문제 vs. 연결성 개선
structure.conclusion: 본론에서 제시한 주요 아이디어를 다시 정리하고, 기술의 긍정적 역할을 재강조하며 에세이를 마무리하세요.

useful_phrases: In my opinion, technology has significantly improved human life.
Furthermore, technology has revolutionized the way we communicate and access information.
For example, medical technology has extended life expectancy and improved quality of life.
Although some argue that technology creates problems, the benefits clearly outweigh the drawbacks.
In conclusion, the positive impact of technology on society is undeniable.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in traditional office environments. Others prefer remote work arrangements. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer remote work because it offers greater flexibility and saves commuting time.
One reason is that remote work allows me to maintain a better work-life balance.
Another advantage is that I can work in a comfortable environment of my own choosing.
However, some people might argue that office environments promote better collaboration.
To summarize, I believe remote work is more beneficial for productivity and personal well-being.
sample_points: 원격 근무의 장점: 유연한 시간 관리, 출퇴근 시간 절약, 개인적인 환경에서의 편안함, 일과 삶의 균형 유지 가능
전통 사무실 근무와의 비교: 협업의 어려움을 언급하면서도 기술을 통한 해결 방안 제시 가능. 예: 비디오 회의, 협업 도구 등이 이러한 문제를 해결할 수 있다고 주장

listening.title: Campus Sustainability Initiative
listening.script:
Professor: Good morning, Sarah. I wanted to discuss our campus sustainability project. Have you had a chance to review the proposal?
Student: Yes, Professor. I'm really interested in the renewable energy component. Can you tell me more about the solar panel installation?
Professor: Of course. We're planning to install 500 solar panels on the roof of the science building. This would generate approximately 30% of the building's energy needs. We estimate it will reduce our carbon footprint by 200 tons annually.
Student: That's impressive. What about the timeline and budget?
Professor: We're looking at an 18-month installation period with a budget of $2 million. However, we expect to recover the investment through energy savings within 10 years. Additionally, we've received a grant that covers 40% of the costs.
Student: That sounds like a solid plan. Are there other initiatives included?
Professor: Yes. We're also implementing a campus-wide recycling program and installing LED lighting throughout the buildings. These measures combined should significantly reduce our environmental impact.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
options: A. To discuss the history of renewable energy on campus
B. To explain a campus sustainability initiative involving solar panels and other green measures
C. To review student complaints about energy consumption
D. To plan a fundraising event for the science building
questions.explanation: 교수와 학생이 캠퍼스 지속 가능성 프로젝트, 특히 태양광 패널 설치 및 기타 환경 보호 조치에 대해 논의하고 있습니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, how much of the science building's energy needs would be met by the solar panels?
questions.explanation: 교수는 500개의 태양광 패널이 건물의 에너지 필요의 약 30%를 생산할 것이라고 명시했습니다.

questions.q: How long is the expected payback period for the solar panel investment?
options: A. 5 years
B. 8 years
C. 10 years
D. 15 years
questions.explanation: 교수는 에너지 절감을 통해 10년 내에 투자 비용을 회수할 수 있을 것으로 예상한다고 말했습니다.
